[MITM]
hostname = tiebac.baidu.com, tieba.baidu.com

[Script]
http-response ^https:\/\/tiebac\.baidu\.com\/livefeed\/feed, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/Script/Tieba/Tieba_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/tiebac\.baidu\.com\/c\/f\/sidebar\/home, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/Script/Tieba/Tieba_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/tiebac\.baidu\.com\/c\/u\/user\/profile, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/Script/Tieba/Tieba_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/tieba\.baidu\.com\/c\/f\/frs\/frsBottom, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/Script/Tieba/Tieba_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^http(s:\/\/tiebac|:\/\/c\.tieba)\.baidu\.com\/(c\/f\/(frs\/(page|threadlist|generalTabList)|pb\/page|excellent\/personalized)$|tiebaads\/commonbatch|c\/s\/sync$), script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/Script/Tieba/tieba-json.js, requires-body=1, timeout=10
